scripts.//: Ecosystem-wide gates. `verify` is what CI runs and what the token drift guard needs, since it is the only place all three apps are checked together.
scripts.verify: npm run verify:colorlab && npm run verify:cheese-booth && npm run verify:live-sop
scripts.verify:colorlab: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.verify:cheese-booth: npm run lint -w apps/cheese-booth && npm run typecheck -w apps/cheese-booth && npm run test -w apps/cheese-booth
scripts.verify:live-sop: npm run lint -w apps/live-sop && npm run typecheck -w apps/live-sop && npm run test -w apps/live-sop
